text:
alex: Quick check — noticed a handful of tenants with sudden drop in prefix cache hit-rate over the last ~3h. Cluster-average looks OK, but per-prefix panels spike low. Where are the raw prefetch logs / sampled keys so I can pull traces?

jia: Grafana panel is here: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prefix-cache/prefix-hitrate — click the table to jump to Loki logs. For raw prefetch logs use Loki stream: `{app=\"kv-prefetch\"}` or filter by `tenant_id`

jia: Example Loki query (copy/paste):
```
{app=\"kv-prefetch\", tenant_id=~\"tenant-.*\"} | json | line_format \"${prefix} ${result} ${duration_ms}\" | sort by duration_ms desc | limit 50
```

sam: The metric to watch is `kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate` (per-prefix label). If the table shows lots of prefixes at 0-10% that's probably a prefetch config regression. Also check `kv_prefetch_attempts_total` and `kv_prefetch_success_total`.

alex: thanks — do we have a dashboard panel that buckets by prefix length or sequence length? I want to see if long prefixes are missing cache entries.

jia: not by default. There's a draft panel in the observability repo: https://git.redwood.com/infra/observability/-/blob/main/dashboards/prefix_metrics.json — it does prefix_length buckets but it's not in prod. I can PR it in if needed.

sam: For alerting, current alert fires on cluster 5m avg < 0.35 which is noisy for small tenants. Recommend switching to 15m window and add `sum by(tenant_id)(requests_total) > 100` to avoid small-traffic false positives.

alex: agreed, noisy. Who owns that alert? ops-oncall: any objection to increasing window and adding minimum traffic threshold? :eyes:

ops-oncall: No objection. FYI it's defined in `alerts/kv_cache_alerts.yaml`. Happy to take the PR; will coordinate change during next maintenance window.

devex-bot: FYI there's a test harness for sampling keys at https://git.redwood.com/devex/kv-synth-tests — run `./run_sample.sh --tenant tenant-123 --prefix pfx:` to generate a sample workload and capture traces.

alex: perfect — I'll pull a sample, share top 20 prefixes, and open a tiny dashboard PR + alert tweak. tagging @jia and @sam for review. :thumbsup:

jia: ping me once you have sample output, I can wire the panel.

sam: I'll review the alert PR. If we see a config regression we should also roll forward the prefetch feature flag to previous version for affected tenants.

alex: will post findings here in ~30m. thanks all.
